metadata.case_name: LIMBU JAS MAYA v. H K SCAFFRAME SYSTEM LTD

injuries.description: A 3-cm laceration was found over her right forehead with bruising.
source: A 3-cm laceration was found over her right forehead with bruising.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Anterior dislocation of her right shoulder with fracture at greater tuberosity of humerus.
source: Examination revealed anterior dislocation of her right shoulder.
After closed reduction, Limbu was discharged the following day.
Examination during follow-up a week later revealed fracture at greater tuberosity without intra-articular involvement.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of shoulder or upper arm

source: Clinically Limbu was complicated with post-traumatic constrictive capsulitis (frozen shoulder).
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: she still complained about soreness at right forehead, right shoulder; right-sided weakness and numbness; low back pain and diabetes mellitus.
Her condition was said to be static with residual shoulder stiffness.
The experts agree that the shoulder condition should not significantly affect Limbu’s daily activities except for overhead activities with her right upper limb.
reduced range of motion of the right shoulder (stiffness)

treatments_received: Limbu was sent by the ambulance to the hospital.
After closed reduction, Limbu was discharged the following day.
She was given a shoulder immobiliser that she had eventually worn for 4 months.

losses.description: Right shoulder residual stiffness and reduced range of motion affecting overhead activities with her right upper limb.
